Romesco, allioli, salsa verda. So the dish arrives just as it left the kitchen.
Every seasonal ingredient, with the name of whoever grows it.

seccions.titol: What data we use and why
text: Orders: your name to call you, the pick-up time and, if you give it, your card's mobile number. We need them to prepare and hand over your order (performance of a contract).
Desbowlitzador card: your name, mobile and, if you like, email. They're used to add words and give you your dessert (performance of a contract).
Updates (padró, Què Queda hour, campaigns): only if you ticked the box, along with the date you did so (consent). You can unsubscribe with one click from any email.

Providers who run the service and only process data on our behalf: Supabase (database, EU), Vercel (hosting), Stripe (payments), Resend (email), Apple and Google (the card in your wallet, if you save it) and Google (AI text drafting, with no personal data).
Orders, for as long as tax law requires. The card, while you keep it active. Updates, until you unsubscribe.

You can ask to see, correct or delete your data, restrict or object to its use and take it with you, by writing to [CORREU]. If you think we're not handling it properly, you can complain to the Catalan Data Protection Authority (apdcat.gencat.cat).

We only use what the website needs to work: your basket and card mobile are stored in your browser (localStorage), the language you choose is stored in a cookie (NEXT_LOCALE) and the owner's panel uses Supabase's session cookie.
We don't use analytics or advertising cookies. That's why there's no consent banner.
When you pay, you do it on Stripe's page, which uses its own cookies to prevent fraud. They explain them at stripe.com/cookie-settings.
